2117151530080178554.en_summary: Crypto finally works beyond Bitcoin. Base's Jesse Pollak says the last 18 months turned crypto into a global financial rail for all financial services, making it easier to build higher-margin financial businesses especially with agents. Base is scaling growth to meet demand for liquidity, assets, and access.
2117151530080178554.zh_summary: 加密貨幣終於超越比特幣發揮作用。Base 的 Jesse Pollak 表示，過去 18 個月加密貨幣已成為適用於所有金融服務的全球金融軌道，特別是在結合代理時，讓建立高利潤金融業務更為容易。Base 正擴大增長以滿足流動性、資產及接入需求。

2117139487083933972.en_summary: With today’s launch of @Tesla’s Robotaxi service in Fort Worth, Texas, its unsupervised Robotaxi geofences now cover a combined ~1% of the entire U.S. population.
2117139487083933972.zh_summary: 隨著 @Tesla 今日在德州 Fort Worth 推出 Robotaxi 服務，其無人監督的 Robotaxi 地理圍欄現已合計覆蓋美國總人口約 1%。

2117134917847093491.en_summary: Agents are shifting roles from helpers to primary workers, turning people into managers of agent teams. Biggest impact on information-heavy jobs like coding, cybersecurity, legal, biotech, and engineering. Leverage decouples from hours worked as agents parallelize tasks, leading to compounding gains for early adopters.
2117134917847093491.zh_summary: 代理正從輔助者轉變為主要工作者，使人們成為代理團隊的管理者。對編碼、網絡安全、法律、生物科技及工程等資訊密集職位影響最大。代理可並行處理任務，使槓桿與工作時數脫鉤，早期採用者將獲得複合增益。

2117134092739252327.en_summary: Tesla's Unsupervised Robotaxi service is now available in 7 cities as of Nov 2nd. Geofence sizes (sq miles): Austin 272, Houston 254, Fort Worth 143 (new), Dallas 81, Miami 31, Orlando 26, Tampa 24.
2117134092739252327.zh_summary: 截至 11 月 2 日，Tesla 的無人監督 Robotaxi 服務現已於 7 個城市提供。地理圍欄面積（平方英里）：Austin 272、Houston 254、Fort Worth 143（新）、Dallas 81、Miami 31、Orlando 26、Tampa 24。

2117129992815726783.en_summary: Tesla has just officially announced a new Robotaxi city, their first new city expansion in ~3 months. Fort Worth, Texas Tesla robotaxi rides begin on November 2nd at 6 AM CT.
2117129992815726783.zh_summary: Tesla 剛正式宣布新的 Robotaxi 城市，為約 3 個月來首次城市擴張。德州 Fort Worth 的 Tesla robotaxi 行程於 11 月 2 日上午 6 時（中部時間）開始。
